title: Clover Causeway
description: A six-bar ground carries four different hearings of a song. Clover Sunshower’s G–B-flat–A–D becomes a longer melody above the returning bass. The second hearing reaches towards E-flat, the third restores the first two melodic bars with a new continuation, and the fourth gathers chords before a quiet G-minor arrival.
difficulty: Intermediate to advanced six-bar ground and melodic voicing
technical_note: Keep the six-bar bass phrase continuous and give the melody its own longer breath. Bars 13–14 recall bars 1–2 exactly; the continuation should sound newly found. The last hearing changes the bass at its close.

performance.note: Four hearings of the same ground gain different melodic destinations. The final cadence releases its repeated bass and becomes still.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
